scenes.setting: The counter-exorcism: fog-power poured through the Sun Brooch condenses a golden figure — too chaotic at 10% strength, until the Dark Emperor card's high-level authority steadies it into a twelve-black-winged colossus that blasts Amon's skeletal grasping hand off the crimson star's boundary
scenes.text_anchor: on its back, it grew pairs of enormous pitch-black wings. There were a total of twelve pairs!

scenes.setting: Derrick basks in the City of Silver's first successful secret deed in two millennia, receives Sun-domain knowledge — then is shown what had been coiled around his spirit: 'Praise you, the mighty Mr. Fool!'
Somewhere in the deep darkness, above a ravine and a rotting one-eyed giant: the real Amon pinches his crystal monocle, smiles — 'As expected… The Fool.' — and leaps into the dark
Threat eliminated, urgency doubled: a mere clone was this terrifying — the Magician's remaining rules must be found, and fast
scenes.text_anchor: For a mere clone to be so bizarre and terrifying, one can imagine how powerful his main body is…
